nightly-eval-bot: nightly-eval run 2026-03-19T03:12Z - id=run-7691 - 18/200 prompt failures, 7 are fncall JSON parse errors. sample attached.

marta: saw the alarm, can you paste one of the failing fncall outputs?

nightly-eval-bot: ```json
{
  "tool": "q_reranker",
  "args": "{\"candidate_ids\":[\"c1\",\"c2\"],\"reason\":\"Lowest confidence:\\u0000 truncated\"}"
}
```

ev an: whoa that \u0000 in the middle of the string. looks like a null byte made it into the JSON string, breaking our parser.

joel: could be encoder/tokenizer inserting a 0x00 for some padding or a bug during KV cache serialization in the quant runtime. which model variant was used?

nightly-eval-bot: model=q4_k_m-2.1.1-quant, runtime=redwood-runtime-2.9, batch=32, prefix_len=64

marta: repro steps request: can someone pull the exact output from the eval artifact (run-7691/artifact/fncall-outputs/15.json) and dump raw bytes? if it's literal 0x00 we need to track where it enters.

sanjay: i'll grab raw bytes now. quick theory: our JSON sanitizer in the harness collapses control chars except NUL; if quantized kernel writes binary sentinel in string boundary that would slip through.

sanjay: pasted raw hex from artifact: ``3b 7b 22 74 6f 6f 6c 22 3a 22 71 5f 72 65 72 61 6e 6b 65 72 22 2c 22 61 72 67 73 22 3a 22 7b 5c 22 63 61 6e 64 69 64 61 74 65 5f 69 64 73 5c 22 3a 5b 5c 22 63 31 5c 22 2c 5c 22 63 32 5c 22 5d 2c 5c 22 72 65 61 73 6f 6e 5c 22 3a 5c 22 4c 6f 77 65 73 74 20 63 6f 6e 66 69 64 65 6e 63 65 3a 00 20 74 72 75 6e 63 61 74 65 64 5c 22 7d 22 7d``

evan: that is definitely a literal 0x00 byte inside the JSON string (right after the colon). that's why our JSON.parse() bombs.

joel: does full-precision (fp16) run produce same? if not it's likely quant runtime bug. sanjay, can you re-run with model=q2_1_fp16 or the unquantized variant?

sanjay: queued a small repro with q2_1_fp16-2.1.1. if fp16 is clean then we narrow to quant path.

marta: for immediate mitigation, can we add a sanitizer step in nightly-eval harness to strip/control-escape NUL bytes before JSON parse and mark the sample as mutated? we want to avoid false positives in alerts.

evan: yes add sanitizer + metric flag sample_sanitized=true so we can audit later. but we must still fix the root cause.

nightly-eval-bot: update: fp16 run finished - same prompt index produced no 0x00 in fp16 output.

marta: summary: repro shows NUL only present in quantized run, fp16 clean => likely quant kernel or serializer inserting sentinel. next steps: 1) sanitzier in harness (evan) 2) add binary-safety test in quant CI using this prompt (joel) 3) triage quant runtime serialization/kvcache (sanjay + marta).

joel: i'll own the CI test. evan, can you add a tiny patch to eval harness today and deploy to nightly to stop noisy alerts?

evan: yep i'll push a small sanitizer PR and toggle metric. link: https://git.local/redwood/evals/pulls/412

marta: assigning owners: @sanjay + @marta root cause triage (deadline EOD tomorrow), @joel CI test, @evan harness sanitizer. i'll raise an incident if we see >5 impacted prompts on next run.

sanjay: starting binary dump of model tensors to check for stray terminator bytes in postproc. will report asap. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
